cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import parse

# Test trailing newline scenarios for R1
tests = [
    ('{}', 'hello\n'),
    ('{:d}', '42\n'),
    ('{:f}', '3.14\n'),
    ('hello {}!', 'hello world!\n'),
    ('hello {:d}!', 'hello 42!\n'),
    ('{:s}', 'hello\n'),
]

print('=== Testing trailing newline handling (R1) ===')
for fmt, val in tests:
    r = parse.parse(fmt, val)
    print(f'parse({fmt!r}, {val!r}) = {r}')
"
